title: List Page - Verify Column Settings functionality on Column Configuration – List Page.
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page

steps.action: Click on the column setting icon
steps.expectedResult: Column setting pop up window should be open

steps.action: Change the sequence of the column and click on the save button
steps.expectedResult: Pop up window should be close and the column sequence should be changed based on the configuration
